name: Compute Cluster S77: Finance Ratios
description: Tests: finance_ratio with all 21 ratio_types across 3 periods. Loads market_data_source, income_statement, balance_sheet, cash_flow and wires inputs explicitly.
source:
# =============================================================================
# COMPUTE CLUSTER S77: Finance Ratios
# =============================================================================
# finance_ratio requires explicit input wiring from data sources.
# Handler auto-fetches data, but script must wire columns to input slots.

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# Load fundamental data sources (TTM for income/CF, quarterly for BS)
inc = income_statement(period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)()
bs = balance_sheet(period=ReportingPeriod.quarterly)()
cf = cash_flow(period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)()

# Load alternate periods for coverage
inc_q = income_statement(period=ReportingPeriod.quarterly)()
inc_a = income_statement(period=ReportingPeriod.annual)()
bs_a = balance_sheet(period=ReportingPeriod.annual)()
cf_q = cash_flow(period=ReportingPeriod.quarterly)()
cf_a = cash_flow(period=ReportingPeriod.annual)()

# === VALUATION RATIOS (TTM) ===
pe_ttm = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.price_to_earnings, period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)(c=close, basic_eps=inc.basic_eps)
ps_ttm = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.price_to_sales, period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)(c=close, basic_shares=inc.basic_shares, revenue=inc.revenue)
ey_ttm = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.earnings_yield, period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)(c=close, basic_eps=inc.basic_eps)
pb_ttm = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.price_to_book, period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)(c=close, basic_shares=inc.basic_shares, total_equity=bs.total_equity)
btm_ttm = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.book_to_market, period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)(c=close, basic_shares=inc.basic_shares, total_equity=bs.total_equity)
mcap_ttm = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.market_cap, period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)(c=close, basic_shares=inc.basic_shares)
ev_ttm = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.enterprise_value, period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)(c=close, basic_shares=inc.basic_shares, lt_debt=bs.lt_debt, cash=bs.cash)
eve_ttm = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.ev_to_ebitda, period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)(c=close, basic_shares=inc.basic_shares, lt_debt=bs.lt_debt, cash=bs.cash, ebitda=inc.ebitda)
evs_ttm = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.ev_to_sales, period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)(c=close, basic_shares=inc.basic_shares, lt_debt=bs.lt_debt, cash=bs.cash, revenue=inc.revenue)

# === PROFITABILITY RATIOS (TTM) ===
gm_ttm = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.gross_margin, period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)(gross_profit=inc.gross_profit, revenue=inc.revenue)
om_ttm = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.operating_margin, period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)(operating_income=inc.operating_income, revenue=inc.revenue)
nm_ttm = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.net_margin, period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)(net_income=inc.net_income, revenue=inc.revenue)
roe_ttm = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.roe, period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)(net_income=inc.net_income, total_equity=bs.total_equity)
roa_ttm = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.roa, period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)(net_income=inc.net_income, total_assets=bs.total_assets)
gpoa_ttm = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.gpoa, period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)(gross_profit=inc.gross_profit, total_assets=bs.total_assets)

# === CASH FLOW (TTM — wired from annual source, Polygon has no TTM/Q cash flow) ===
fcf_ttm = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.free_cash_flow, period=ReportingPeriod.trailing_twelve_months)(ncf_operating=cf_a.ncf_operating, capex=cf_a.capex)

# === LIQUIDITY RATIOS (Quarterly — native BS period) ===
cr_q = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.current_ratio, period=ReportingPeriod.quarterly)(current_assets=bs.current_assets, current_liabilities=bs.current_liabilities)
qr_q = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.quick_ratio, period=ReportingPeriod.quarterly)(current_assets=bs.current_assets, inventories=bs.inventories, current_liabilities=bs.current_liabilities)
cashr_q = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.cash_ratio, period=ReportingPeriod.quarterly)(cash=bs.cash, current_liabilities=bs.current_liabilities)

# === LEVERAGE RATIOS (Quarterly) ===
dte_q = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.debt_to_equity, period=ReportingPeriod.quarterly)(total_liabilities=bs.total_liabilities, total_equity=bs.total_equity)
dr_q = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.debt_ratio, period=ReportingPeriod.quarterly)(total_liabilities=bs.total_liabilities, total_assets=bs.total_assets)

# === ANNUAL PERIOD COVERAGE ===
pe_a = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.price_to_earnings, period=ReportingPeriod.annual)(c=close, basic_eps=inc_a.basic_eps)
gm_a = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.gross_margin, period=ReportingPeriod.annual)(gross_profit=inc_a.gross_profit, revenue=inc_a.revenue)
cr_a = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.current_ratio, period=ReportingPeriod.annual)(current_assets=bs_a.current_assets, current_liabilities=bs_a.current_liabilities)
fcf_a = finance_ratio(ratio_type=FinanceRatioType.free_cash_flow, period=ReportingPeriod.annual)(ncf_operating=cf_a.ncf_operating, capex=cf_a.capex)

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Valuation: P/E and Earnings Yield (TTM)',
    category='Valuation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='P/E', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Earnings Yield', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(pe_ttm, ey_ttm))

xy_lines(
    title='Valuation: P/B and Book-to-Market (TTM)',
    category='Valuation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='P/B', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='B/M', color=Color.Green)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(pb_ttm, btm_ttm))

xy_lines(
    title='Market Cap & Enterprise Value (TTM)',
    category='Valuation',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Market Cap', color=Color.Cyan),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='EV', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(mcap_ttm, ev_ttm))

xy_lines(
    title='Profitability Margins (TTM)',
    category='Profitability',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Gross', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Operating', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Net', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(gm_ttm, om_ttm, nm_ttm))

xy_lines(
    title='Return Ratios (TTM)',
    category='Profitability',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ROE', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='ROA', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='GPOA', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(roe_ttm, roa_ttm, gpoa_ttm))

xy_lines(
    title='Liquidity Ratios (Quarterly)',
    category='Balance Sheet',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Current', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Quick', color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cash', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(cr_q, qr_q, cashr_q))

xy_lines(
    title='Leverage Ratios (Quarterly)',
    category='Balance Sheet',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='D/E', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Debt Ratio', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(dte_q, dr_q))

xy_lines(
    title='Free Cash Flow (TTM vs Annual)',
    category='Cash Flow',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='TTM', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Annual', color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(fcf_ttm, fcf_a))
